entries.title: Numbers 12:1
segments: ¶Then Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married; for he had married an Ethiopian woman.

entries.title: Numbers 12:2
segments: So they said, "Has the LORD indeed spoken only through Moses? Has He not spoken through us also?" And the LORD heard [it].

entries.title: Numbers 12:3
segments: (Now the man Moses [was] very humble, more than all men who [were] on the face of the earth.)

entries.title: Numbers 12:4
segments: ¶Suddenly the LORD said to Moses, Aaron, and Miriam, "Come out, you three, to the tabernacle of meeting!" So the three came out.

entries.title: Numbers 12:5
segments: Then the LORD came down in the pillar of cloud and stood [in] the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam. And they both went forward.

entries.title: Numbers 12:6
segments: Then He said, "Hear now My words: If there is a prophet among you, [I], the LORD, make Myself known to him in a vision; I speak to him in a dream.

entries.title: Numbers 12:7
segments: Not so with My servant Moses; He [is] faithful in all My house.

entries.title: Numbers 12:8
segments: I speak with him face to face, Even plainly, and not in dark sayings; And he sees the form of the LORD. Why then were you not afraid To speak against My servant Moses?"

entries.title: Numbers 12:9
segments: So the anger of the LORD was aroused against them, and He departed.

entries.title: Numbers 12:10
segments: ¶And when the cloud departed from above the tabernacle, suddenly Miriam [became] leprous, as [white as] snow. Then Aaron turned toward Miriam, and there she was, a leper.

entries.title: Numbers 12:11
segments: So Aaron said to Moses, "Oh, my lord! Please do not lay [this] sin on us, in which we have done foolishly and in which we have sinned.

entries.title: Numbers 12:12
segments: "Please do not let her be as one dead, whose flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother's womb!"

entries.title: Numbers 12:13
segments: So Moses cried out to the LORD, saying, "Please heal her, O God, I pray!"

entries.title: Numbers 12:14
segments: Then the LORD said to Moses, "If her father had but spit in her face, would she not be shamed seven days? Let her be shut out of the camp seven days, and afterward she may be received [again]."

entries.title: Numbers 12:15
segments: So Miriam was shut out of the camp seven days, and the people did not journey till Miriam was brought in [again].

entries.title: Numbers 12:16
segments: And afterward the people moved from Hazeroth and camped in the Wilderness of Paran.
